svg.text: 3.3 V logic. The Pi has no analog input: an ADS1115 (I2C) reads the detector. Never put more than 3.3 V on any GPIO.

GND star point (one place, near the SBC)
Supplies are not wired from the SBC: see power-tree.svg. Boards share ground through the star point and the RF coax shields.
